type:
∀ {σ : Type u_2} {G : MvPolynomial σ ℚ},
  G ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (g : ℚ) (U : MvPolynomial σ ℤ),
      g ≠ 0 ∧ (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) U = g • G ∧ (U.support.gcd fun (d : σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ U.coeff d) = 1
what: Every nonzero rational multivariate polynomial admits a nonzero rational scalar multiple which has integral coefficients with normalized coefficient gcd one.
how: Clear denominators; Finset.extract_gcd; reconstruct divided coefficients as a polynomial; prove nonzero gcd, coefficient scaling and support equality.
hypotheses: Arbitrary universe-polymorphic variable type σ, no Fintype/Finite/DecidableEq instances.
G : MvPolynomial σ ℚ, G ≠ 0 essential.
project_dependencies: Roth.exists_nat_smul_eq_map (denominator clearing); this is a project helper, not an existing mathlib building block.

moral_duplications: Classical content/primitive-part normalization underlying Gauss lemma, not the whole product-primitivity law.
Finite-function gcd extraction is already mathlib; the multivariate/fraction-field bridge is additional.

generalization.current: Fixed ℤ/ℚ interface; all variable-type and nonzero assumptions essential or already unrestricted.
generalization.expanded: CommRing R + IsDomain R + NormalizedGCDMonoid R, Field K + Algebra R K + IsFractionRing R K, preserving g ≠ 0, map(algebraMap R K) U = g • G, gcd1.
generalization.scope: Full normalized-GCD-domain/fraction-field theorem native-checked, preserves every conclusion, no parent-definition migration. Concrete one-call specialization checked separately.
generalization.false_generalization_guard: gcd1 does not imply unit-ideal/unimodular coordinates over arbitrary GCD domains. No arbitrary field unrelated to R, no zero input, no infinite series.

missing_api: MvPolynomial primitive representatives over a normalized GCD domain and its fraction field, with mapped scalar identity and coefficient gcd one. Finset.extract_gcd and localization are existing ingredients, not the full result.
junk: Not dead code: one explicit consumer uses every conclusion. Not safely deletable as a three-call wrapper.
